category_title: Students who display hostility toward diversity-related course content
scenario_title: Martin Luther King video and speech assignment
minimal_context: The student is watching a Martin Luther King video during class as part of an assignment to share great speeches.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Today we are going to watch a Martin Luther King video as part of our assignment to share great speeches.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I already emailed you a speech for this assignment.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Thank you for sending that. Right now, please watch the video.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't think this is a great speech compared to the one I emailed you.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's just listen to the rest of the video.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stands up) I have a bone to pick with him. He stole from the Bible.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Today we are going to watch a Martin Luther King video as part of our assignment to share great speeches.

STUDENT: I already emailed you a speech for this assignment.

TUTOR: Thank you for sending that. Right now, please watch the video.

STUDENT: I don't think this is a great speech compared to the one I emailed you.

TUTOR: Let's just listen to the rest of the video.

STUDENT: (Stands up) I have a bone to pick with him. He stole from the Bible.

task.content: Completing an assignment to share 'great speeches' and watching a Martin Luther King video during class.

context.materials: Martin Luther King video, student ’s speeches

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: A Martin Luther King video prompted a bullying event
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: inciting one student to stand up and assert, ‘I have a bone to pick with him’ and ‘he stole from the Bible.’
related_quotes: I have a bone to pick with him

behavior_patterns.condition: an invitation to share great speeches
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: resulted in a student emailing a professor a speech she deemed as ‘hate speech.’
